records.supportedMechanism: UPI, BharatNet and Common Service Centres operate as concrete technical and institutional carriers through which payments and public digital services are routed at national scale.
contradictions: Scale does not imply uniform access or service quality.
unknowns: Distributional gaps and service-quality variation remain outside this candidate.

records.supportedMechanism: Current manufacturing output and commissioned freight-terminal capacity show an already-operating production/logistics system coordinating output, freight handling and investment.
contradictions: Growth and capacity are uneven across sectors and regions.
unknowns: Persistence beyond the current observation window.

records.supportedMechanism: Large crude-import exposure and elevated fuel-and-power inflation actively constrain the cost structure and flexibility of the current industrial-economic runtime.
unknowns: Constraint strength varies across sectors and may change with prices, domestic production and fuel substitution.

records.supportedMechanism: India retains a large working-age share while fertility declines and ageing gradually rises.
unknowns: The evidence is partly projection-based and does not by itself establish an operational continuity mechanism sufficient for RP admission.

boundary: P2 candidates require direct evidence of ongoing operation or active constraint. Demographic projection is retained as reference-only rather than forced into P3 admission.
